# Phil Pegram

> Head of Insights, Analytics and Market Research at TalkTalk, 2026 Insight250 winner and DBA researcher at Teesside University. Writes and speaks on customer insight, evidence-led decisions and how insight teams are organised.

Views on this site are Phil's own, not his employer's. The research briefs summarise academic submissions. They are not peer-reviewed journal articles and are not evidence of commercial results at TalkTalk.

## Key pages

- [About](https://philpegram.com/about): biography, career and recognition
- [My work](https://philpegram.com/work): customer understanding, decision quality and insight operating models
- [Research and writing](https://philpegram.com/writing): index of research briefs
- [Speaking and media](https://philpegram.com/speaking): talk topics, short bio and headshot
- [Contact](https://philpegram.com/contact): LinkedIn is the contact route

## Research briefs

- [Organisational evidence capacity](https://philpegram.com/evidence-capacity): DBA critical literature review of 47 sources on commissioning, analytical capacity and evidence use in third sector organisations. Single-reviewer synthesis; it does not establish causation.
- [Military skills, careers and social mobility](https://philpegram.com/military-transition): MBA dissertation (University of Staffordshire, May 2025) using secondary data on veterans' career trajectories and social return on training investment. Cross-sectional; it identifies associations only.
